programme.title: College Football

programme.desc: At the end of March 1945, with the German Army utterly depleted and Hitler's circle of trust rapidly shrinking, Hitler invites a group of Hitler Youth to the Reich Chancellery gardens to be congratulated. These are the people upon whom he now relies, children.

programme.title: Cutting It

programme.title: NHL Hockey

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.desc: The Senators continue a comeback attempt as they host the Maple Leafs in Game 6 of an East quarterfinal. Linus Ullmark made 29 saves as Ottawa blanked Toronto 4-0 in Game 5 to stay alive. Tim Stützle notched a goal and two assists for the Sens.
